© 2026 EV — personal memory companion
EV listens continuously while the app is open so you can talk without a wake word. Audio is processed on your device and the local EV API.
EV controls Messages, Mail, and System Events only when you invoke EVLifeHelper commands (send texts/email, read inboxes, drive apps).
EV discovers and uses Bluetooth peripherals you explicitly pair (keyboard, mouse, health belt) for presence and readiness.
EV uses the camera only when you explicitly capture a photo or video note.
EV reads and creates calendar events only for the HUD and routine features you enable.
EV resolves contacts only when you ask it to (EVLifeHelper contacts.list / contacts.resolve).
EV uses your location only while you are actively using a location-aware HUD card.
EV reads and creates reminders only for routine follow-ups you enable.
EV uses screen content only when you enable ambient context collectors, and never sends raw pixels to any model.
EV uses on-device speech recognition for quick dictation capture when you enable it.
